Commit-reveal sybil gate bound to a future beacon. Candidates post H(identity, salt) plus a 2-unit deposit; only tickets with H(salt, R) under a 0.25 threshold take seats after beacon R.

Flow: commit and deposit; beacon emits R; reveal salt within 5 blocks; passes take seats, misses forfeit deposits. R is the sole admission signal, unknown at commit time, so bulk pre-registration fails.

To forge N seats needs about 4N tickets, locking 8N units; missed reveals burn deposits, so one faked seat costs 8 versus 2 honest. A quartz timestamp blocks replays.
